title: Privileged access management and session controls
workflow: Receive time-bounded access request with ticket
Check user identity, institution, scope and current policy
Require independent owner approval and strong authentication
Grant minimum privileges to specified systems
Monitor actions and preserve redacted privileged-session evidence
Revoke automatically at expiry and review emergency actions
invariants: Developers do not hold permanent production ledger-admin roles
Self-approval and standing break-glass grants are prohibited
Database superuser actions cannot bypass financial controls
Access to customer data requires lawful operational purpose
Every privileged session binds to accountable individual
Revocation must invalidate subsequent role decisions
planned_tests: Session transcript proves actor and action without secrets
approval_gate: CISO and regulated-institution access policy, real PAM/IAM integration and privileged-activity tests.
